- **Purpose:** Compare task scores between sexes
- **Input:** wide score df
- **Output:** 
  - df with FC and pvalues
  - plots
  
```{r}
library(ggrepel)
```

```{r}
load("data/processed/scores_long.RData")
```

# join task numbers and names

```{r}
tasklist <- read.xlsx('data/SWAP_input/tasklist_test_gtex.xlsx')

tasklist_names <- tasklist %>%
  filter(!is.na(ID)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c('ID', 'DESCRIPTION', 'SHOULD.FAIL')) %>%
  mutate(ID = paste('task', ID, sep = '_'))
```

```{r}
df_results_scores <- df_results_scores %>%
  left_join(tasklist_names, join_by('task' == 'ID')) %>%
  mutate(task_name = paste0(task, ': ', DESCRIPTION))
```

# join df containing sex information
```{r}
load('data/raw/counts_subset.RData')
load('data/raw/samples_and_subjects_clean_subset.RData')
```

replace sample numbers with name
```{r}
samples_names <- colnames(counts_subset)[grepl('GTEX', colnames(counts_subset))]
df_results_scores$sample_name <- samples_names[df_results_scores$sample]
```

```{r}
df_results_scores <- df_results_scores %>%
  left_join(samples_and_subjects_clean_subset %>%
              dplyr::select(SAMPID, donor_ID, SEX),
            join_by('sample_name' == 'SAMPID'))
```

# compute FC and pvalue

```{r}
list_tasks <- unique(df_results_scores$task)
```

```{r}
df_scores_wide <- df_results_scores %>%
  dplyr::select(donor_ID, task, score, SEX) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = 'task', values_from = 'score')
```


```{r}
compare_sexes <- function(task, df) {
  
  print(paste0('running for ', task))
  
  formula <- as.formula(paste('rank(', task, ')~ SEX'))
  results <- lm(formula, df)
  anova_results <- car::Anova(results)
  
  pvalue_sex <- anova_results['SEX', 'Pr(>F)']
  
  FC <- median(df[[task]][df[['SEX']] == 2], na.rm = T) / median(df[[task]][df[['SEX']] == 1], na.rm = T)
  
  return(data.frame('task' = task, 'pvalue_sex' = pvalue_sex, 'FC' = FC, 'df' = deparse(substitute(df))))
  
}

compare_sexes('task_411', df_scores_wide)

```

apply to all tasks
```{r}
df_results_sex_comparison <- lapply(list_tasks, compare_sexes, df = df_scores_wide) %>%
  bind_rows(.)
```

adjust pvalue and add task name
```{r}
df_results_sex_comparison_clean <- df_results_sex_comparison %>%
  left_join(tasklist_names, join_by('task' == 'ID')) %>%
  mutate(adj_pval_sex = p.adjust(pvalue_sex, method = 'BH'),
         plot_sign = case_when(adj_pval_sex < 0.05 & FC - 1 > 0.1 ~ 'sign_F',
                               adj_pval_sex < 0.05 & 1 - FC > 0.1 ~ 'sign_M',
                               .default = 'not_sign'),
         task_name = paste0(task, ': ', DESCRIPTION))
```

volcano plot
```{r}

palette_plot_sign = c("sign_M" = "#4A6FA5", "sign_F" = "#D64550", "not_sign" = 'grey')


ggplot(df_results_sex_comparison_clean, aes(x = FC, y = -log2(adj_pval_sex), 
                                            color = plot_sign))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_hline(yintercept =  -log2(0.05), linetype = 'dashed', color = 'black')+
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.9, 1.1), linetype = 'dashed', color = 'black')+
  scale_color_manual(values = palette_plot_sign) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(df_results_sex_comparison_clean, plot_sign != 'not_sign'),
    aes(label = stringr::str_wrap(task_name, 35)),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,   # don't drop labels when the plot is crowded
    show.legend = FALSE   # keeps the legend from showing an "a" glyph
  ) +
  theme_minimal()+
  labs(y = "-log2 pvalue",
       x = 'Fold change')
```
in this case nothing is significant so not very pretty 

boxplot specific tasks by sex
```{r}
plot_by_sex <- function(df, var, log_scale = F){
  
  plot <- ggplot(df, aes(y = .data[[var]], x = SEX, fill = SEX, color = SEX))+
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), alpha = 0.25)+
    geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0, alpha = 0.5, size = 1)+
    theme_minimal()+
    scale_fill_manual(values =  c("#4A6FA5", "#D64550"))+
    scale_color_manual(values =  c("#4A6FA5", "#D64550"))+
    guides(fill = 'none')
  
  if (log_scale) plot <- plot + scale_y_log10()
  
  return(plot)
}

plot_by_sex(df = df_scores_wide, var = 'task_411')
```
